name: io.perigon/mcp
title: Perigon MCP
description: Live Perigon news intelligence for articles, stories, sources, companies, and people.

tools.name: search_news_articles
tools.description: Search individual news articles with advanced filtering

tools.name: search_news_stories
tools.description: Search clustered news stories and headlines

tools.name: search_story_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical article counts for a story

tools.name: search_vector_news
tools.description: Semantic vector search over news articles

tools.name: summarize_news
tools.description: AI-powered summarization of a news query

tools.name: search_journalists
tools.description: Find journalists by name, publication, or topic

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Discover news publications and media outlets

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search public figures and newsworthy individuals

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find corporations and businesses by name or domain

tools.name: search_topics
tools.description: Browse available Perigon topic taxonomy

tools.name: search_wikipedia
tools.description: Search Wikipedia with advanced filtering

tools.name: search_vector_wikipedia
tools.description: Semantic vector search over Wikipedia

tools.name: get_avg_sentiment
tools.description: Average sentiment scores over a time range

tools.name: get_article_counts
tools.description: Article publication volume over time

tools.name: get_top_entities
tools.description: Most-mentioned topics, people, companies, and sources

tools.name: get_top_people
tools.description: People with the largest coverage spikes

tools.name: get_top_companies
tools.description: Companies with the largest coverage spikes

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Recent news for a specific company in one call

tools.name: get_person_news
tools.description: Recent news about a specific person in one call

tools.name: get_location_news
tools.description: Recent news for a city, state, or country in one call

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List and search monitors by name, status, or classification

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: Retrieve a monitor's configuration by UUID

tools.name: get_monitor_events
tools.description: Retrieve structured events from EVENT and MENTIONS monitors

tools.name: get_monitor_newsletters
tools.description: Retrieve scheduled briefings, typically from TOPIC monitors

tools.name: get_monitor_summaries
tools.description: Retrieve rolling AI-generated monitor summary history

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Create a DRAFT or ACTIVE monitor with query and output configuration

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Partially update monitor configuration and delivery settings

tools.name: set_monitor_status
tools.description: Activate, pause, or irreversibly archive a monitor

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer API key. Public resources need no key; tools and prompts require one.
